ANSWER: Yes, Delta ranks #1 in both operating margin (9.73%) and net margin (5.61%) for FY2024. However, Alaska's ranking (3rd in both metrics) is not fully comparable to the others due to its partial-year consolidation of the Hawaiian Holdings acquisition beginning September 18, 2024.
